newsitem.title: USA: Clinton delcares S.Dakota major disaster area.
newsitem.headline: Clinton delcares S.Dakota major disaster area.

text.p: President Clinton declared Friday that a major disaster exists in South Dakota, freeing federal aid for victims hit by severe winter storms and blizzards that have battered the state since Jan. 3.

Under the terms of the disaster declaration, the federal government will pay part of the cost of clearing snow emergency routes to provide emergency access for vehicles and other emergency assistance, the Federal Emergency Management Agency said in a statement.
Clinton's action made federal disaster relief funds available to local governments and individuals in all 66 counties in the state.
